summaries.Romania: Romania faces political uncertainty as President Nicușor Dan prepares to designate a new prime minister, while the country watches rising far-right movements in neighboring Germany with concern. Economic challenges persist with ongoing construction disruptions and infrastructure repairs across major cities.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with smart ring maker Oura filing for IPO and AI-driven health platforms expanding, while policymakers debate affordability reforms and Medicare oversight continues on drug eligibility and surprise billing practices.
summaries.Tech: Europe achieves a major space milestone with Germany's Isar Aerospace launching the first fully commercial orbital rocket, while Apple faces internal reorganization over App Store revenue strategies and AI integration deepens across healthcare and consumer applications.

items.title: Nicușor Dan ar putea desemna luni premierul. Ce condiții pune pentru viitorul șef al Guvernului (surse)
items.snippet: Președintele Nicușor Dar ar putea anunța luni, 7 septembrie, numele premierului desemnat, potrivit surselor Digi24 apropiate de Administrația Prezidențială. items.line: Romania's political transition hinges on Nicușor Dan's choice of prime minister, with potential for an independent candidate to bridge parliamentary divides.

items.title: Smart ring maker Oura files to go public, pitching investors on AI-driven preventive health
items.snippet: Oura, the smart ring maker and health tracking company, filed to go public on Thursday to fuel its next phase of growth as it aims to build an artificial intelligence-powered health platform.
items.line: Oura's IPO filing demonstrates investor appetite for AI-powered preventive health platforms that integrate continuous biometric monitoring with predictive analytics.

items.title: German company becomes first in Europe to launch fully commercial orbital rocket
items.snippet: "We achieved within a few years what had taken the European space industry decades before."
items.line: Isar Aerospace's successful orbital rocket launch ends Europe's dependence on non-European providers and validates commercial space access as economically viable.

items.title: Scan.com raises $220M to expand US medical imaging network
items.snippet: The company plans to use the funding to further expand its U.S. network of imaging providers, as well as invest in its API and agentic AI infrastructure.
items.line: Scan.com's $220M funding round shows accelerating consolidation in medical imaging networks as agentic AI reshapes diagnostic delivery infrastructure.

items.title: Oncology company Thyme Care raises $125M, backed by Morgan Health, Humana and CVS Health Ventures
items.snippet: Thyme Care landed a series E financing round of more than $125 million backed by strategic payers and providers as it aims to expand beyond cancer care navigation.
items.line: Thyme Care's $125M Series E backed by payers signals major health systems recognizing oncology navigation as a model for expanding beyond disease-specific care.

items.title: Phil Schiller’s App Store exit reportedly driven by wariness over future plans
items.snippet: Schiller reportedly had reservations about new CEO John Ternus' goal of bringing in more recurring revenue from the App Store.
items.line: Phil Schiller's exit from Apple's App Store division over revenue strategy disagreements signals internal conflict about iOS ecosystem monetization under new CEO John Ternus.

items.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
